title: Chakravyuham: The Trap
desc: Satya, an investigating officer, strives to overcome multiple challenges to solve the murder case of a businessman's wife.

title: Penguin
desc: Rhythm, a pregnant woman, is traumatised by nightmares about the unsolved kidnapping of her first child, Ajay. Later, she embarks on a harrowing mission to solve the mystery of his disappearance.

title: Dear Comrade
desc: Bobby, a student union leader with anger issues, falls in love with Lilly, a state-level cricketer. However, his temperament poses an obstacle in his path to be with her.

title: Maari
desc: Maari, a criminal, constantly troubles the people in his locality and extorts money from them. But his life changes when Sridevi, a pretty woman, falls in love with him.

title: Majili
desc: Poorna, an aspiring cricketer, falls into a deep depression after being abandoned by his lover, Anshu. Despite this, he is forced to marry his neighbour Sravani, who secretly has feelings for him.
Sathya, a young policeman, curses his luck when he gets posted in a control room. However, his life takes an unusual turn after the 100th call he overhears.

title: Visithiran
desc: A retired policeman known for his investigative skills grieves the death of his wife. However, things take a turn when he gets embroiled in a human trafficking case.

title: Judwaa 2
desc: Raja and Prem, twins separated at birth but connected through reflexes, join forces as adults to take down an underground smuggling kingpin who threatens to destroy their family.

title: Un Kadal Thadathil
desc: Hari and Eeshwar are two soldiers fighting the Nazi forces during World War II. Hari has to sacrifice his love and life to make a mistrustful Eeshwar understand some facts about living in harmony.

title: Super Hit Songs
desc: A comprehensive compilation of the greatest super hit songs is played back to back in order to entertain and enthrall the audience.

title: Loafer
desc: Raja, a young thief, lives with his father and believes his mother to be dead. However, things become complicated when he comes across Mouni, a runaway girl, and falls for her.

title: Azhagu Kutti Chellam
desc: The lives of several families become intertwined over a common thread between them.

title: Kumki
desc: Bomman, a mahout, and his elephant are assigned to protect the crops of a hill tribe from a rogue elephant. However, his life takes a turn when he falls in love with the village leader's daughter.

title: F2: Fun and Frustration
desc: Two young men hope to control their wives after their respective marriages. However, their chauvinistic attitude often lands them in hilarious situations.

title: Takkar
desc: A man who wants to be a millionaire meets a woman with a distaste for money. Their chance encounter, however, leads to an unexpected adventure.

title: Hanu Man
desc: A local thief, who lives in the village of Anjanadri, comes across a Hanuman-like power. He must protect people from the peril that looms over them.

title: Kazhugumalai Ganesh
desc: A film-maker aspires to make a gangster movie and selects the hardened Gaddalakonda Ganesh as his subject. Soon, he and his friend put their lives on the line to follow Gaddalakonda's life.
